posts.title: Once upon a time… an adventure
posts.description: The first instalment of a new column by John Vanderaart, devoted entirely to adventure games. This article first appeared in Commodore Dossier No. 6, summer 1986.

posts.title: C64 Machine language: more instructions
posts.description: This is the fourth article in a series of four, in which Roelf Sluman talks about the use of machine code [on the Commodore 64]. Through sample programmes we’ll discuss different aspects of programming 6502 machine code. “Judging from the letters we get, more and more Commodore hobbyists are aware of BASIC’s limitations. The next step is all but inevitable: writing programmes in machine language.” This article first appeared in Commodore Dossier No. 5, 1985.
